ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen to the shrimp population if all the detritus were extinct?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows detritus near the bottom center. Freshwater shrimp is positioned above it, and there is an arrow going from detritus up to freshwater shrimp. Reasoning: In this food web, the arrow indicates detritus is a food or energy resource for freshwater shrimp. If all detritus became extinct, freshwater shrimp would lose that food source, so their population would go down.
